verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows admin-configurable retention policies that auto-delete transcripts or recordings on a schedule, and nothing documents a permanent on-demand erase, such as a delete mutation or purge feature. The '0-day data retention policy' applies to Fireflies' vendors and partners, not to customer-set retention. The Rules Engine is described only as controlling meeting access and privacy, and the optional share expiry limits link access rather than deleting data, so all three are adjacent controls.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
